profile.headline: TPM previously an Engineer (10yrs) with deep in the weeds knowledge
profile.summary:
I am open to and actively seeking a new job! Roles I'm interested in include: Technical Program/Product/Project Manager, Engineering Manager, Frontend Engineer.

I do my best work in environments where there’s real trust, autonomy, and psychological safety. I’ve found that teams perform best when they’re given ownership over how they work, with support and guidance instead of micromanagement. My goal in any role is to help establish these conditions by creating space for teams to experiment, learn quickly, and continuously improve so they can deliver reliable work at a consistently high level. I’m especially motivated by roles where I can partner closely with engineers and leaders to build systems, culture, and practices that scale both effectiveness and resilience.

Any role I’d seriously consider would need to check a few key boxes first:
$185k+ per year base salary
Remote first
Clear purpose and expectations
A diverse team that includes some mid and junior members
Executives that prioritize team wellbeing

positions.title: Senior Technical Product Manager
positions.description:
Led cross-functional teams to define technical product strategy for website enhancements, delivering iterative releases via Agile sprints

Aligned UX/UI, e-commerce, and international teams to prioritize features according to business objectives

Prioritized customer needs through research-informed backlog decisions, improving user satisfaction

Drove continuous improvement initiatives to optimize processes

Tracked team KPIs—velocity and commit-to-complete ratios—to guide performance improvements and technical debt management
positions.insights: Skills: Senior Stakeholder Management · Flexible Approach · Engineering Management · Agile Project Management

positions.title: Technical Program Manager
positions.description:
Defined project management processes and established product roadmap planning

Coordinated sprint ceremonies and resource allocation to improve delivery predictability using Agile frameworks

Managed both backend and frontend application release cadences

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Member of initial engineering team, helped define process around product and project management as well as agile methodologies

Contributing engineer to nonprofit software tooling (React)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Member of initial digital products team; core participant in conceptualizing and implementing product-scape including membership, education, and web presence of play, tuning, and tab apps

Contributing engineer to video-based learning platform (React)

Collaborated on React boilerplate for initial project definitions

Lead engineer on homegrown content management system (Ember)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Coordinated with product and marketing teams to deliver site suite garnering 37M+ unique monthly visitors

Full stack contributions in Ruby on Rails back end/Ember JS front end to internal tooling for more efficient cross-team collaborations

Lead A/B testing, data analysis, and sponsorship/product integrations on LiveNation.com properties

Worked closely with dev ops to improve deployment and release processes

positions.title: Digital Product Manager
positions.description:
Conceptualized and implemented digital content marketing strategies for Live Nation and Ticketmaster properties

Lead data analysis and evaluation for advertorial content across Live Nation and Ticketmaster web presences

Collaborated on sponsorship pitches and ran brand partnership metrics for Virgin, Skype, Bose, Kellogg’s, and more

Assisted in driving 200-300% 2013 & 2014 year over year increases in website traffic, page views, video views, engagement, search, and other key metrics

Launched live streaming for the brand, including the platform for Live Nation's Yahoo! Initiative -- live streaming a concert every night for 365 days

Assisted SVP of content and marketing to manage creation and execution of strategic partnerships

positions.title: Event Production, Social Media, Marketing, & PR
positions.description:
Day-of event production and coordination, liaison for sponsor and vendor contacts, logistics and timeline management

Social media branding campaigns, content operations, and analytical status reports

Strategize, execute, and manage PR campaigns in both corporate and grassroots environments, create and manage press lists

Specialize in film and tv, technology, emerging markets, early adopters, brand and events, nonprofit, music and festivals, studio junkets, industry publications and media, fashion, awards shows

positions.title: Account Manager
positions.description:
Acted as main point of contact to all social media and digital accounts.

Consulted on street/interactive campaigns.

Trafficked brand media buys, implemented social media strategies, and advised on marketing recommendations.

positions.title: Social Media Operations
positions.description:
Contributed to and explored audience development and engagement strategies in the social media realm.

Facilitated on-brand messaging for entertainment brands including Hulu, Cambio, Sonic, and Ovation TV.

positions.title: Talent Assistant
positions.description:
Assisted senior agents in booking, scheduling, and developing and maintaining publicity contacts.

Managed beauty contacts and credit programs for roster of 55 artists and over 75 assistants in L.A. and New York.

positions.title: Social Media Consultant
positions.description:
Assumed social media promotion duties with management.

Designed collateral and produced and updated Twitter and Facebook accounts.

positions.title: Director of Events
positions.description:
Facilitated vendor relations and negotiations for over 50 corporate events per year in the greater Boston area.

Determined and managed budget for each event.

positions.title: Digital & Brand Communications Intern
positions.description:
Conceptualized social media campaigns for projects on brand and personality accounts.

Assisted on media relations projects for a number of lifestyle brand accounts.

Updated media lists, crafted pitches, conducted media outreach, and provided up to date research.

Participated in client calls, brainstorming sessions, and company events.

positions.title: Marketing and Social Media Consultant
positions.description:
Counseled start-up business on basic marketing and public relations techniques including company backgrounder, pitch letters, press releases, and creative and strategic planning.

Assisted in establishing brand in local sector and advising management in marketing approaches, specifically social media.
